concerns.text: FR-007 contains a recursive self-reference and malformed logic: 'The system MUST halt and log the specific missing variable. The system assumes standard OpenNeuro BIDS metadata... (See FR-007)'. The requirement text includes its own citation as part of the logic description, creating a circular definition that breaks the traceability chain. It anchors to itself rather than a User Story.

FR-007 claims to anchor to US-1 via '(See US-1)' at the very end, but the preceding text is a recursive loop referencing FR-007 itself. The actual anchoring to US-1 is obscured by the malformed text block. The requirement needs to be rewritten to clearly separate the validation logic from the citation.

SC-004 anchors to FR-006 ('See FR-006'), but FR-006 is a visualization requirement ('System MUST generate visualizations...'). SC-004 describes a validation metric ('Topographic consistency... measured against... literature'). While related, the Success Criteria should ideally anchor to the specific analysis requirement (FR-005) that generates the data being validated, or the requirement should explicitly state it validates the output of FR-005. The current anchor to a visualization FR is weak.
